environment: dirty local working tree and loopback synthetic preview
applicability_reason: The project targets Spain and appears commercial, but the legal operator, establishment and precise information-society-service role are not confirmed.
expected: If LSSI applies, the site must provide permanent, easy, direct and free access to the operator information required by the applicable provisions.
observed: The release gate correctly hides all legal links unless four approved legal documents exist, but no approved operator identity or legal notice is present for a public release.
method: Static review of legal projection, footer and release validation; official BOE review of LSSI article 10.
limitations: No company certificate, tax identity, registry details, authorisations or final operator establishment were supplied.
impact: A public commercial service could launch without mandatory operator disclosure and without a legally approved notice.
prevalence: Global footer and all public routes.

source_refs.legal_effect: Requires covered providers to make specified general information permanently, easily, directly and freely accessible.
source_refs.instrument: Ley 34/2002 de servicios de la sociedad de la información y de comercio electrónico
source_refs.applicability_reason: Likely relevant to a Spanish-targeted commercial web service, subject to operator and scope confirmation.
source_refs.verification_method: Official BOE ELI consolidated text and article review.

false_positive_analysis: The current public runtime is intentionally held closed, so this is not presented as an observed live omission from an active commercial service.
counterevidence: Legal documents and footer links are fail-closed until release approval.
remediation_minimum: Confirm the legal operator and obtain approved operator data and a legal notice; bind the approval record to the exact content snapshot before opening release.
additional_hardening: Automate a release assertion that operator data, legal document hashes and canonical origin match the signed approval package.
retest: Verify the approved notice in every locale and at the deployed origin without bypassing the release gate.
residual_risk: Material until operator identity, scope and final text are confirmed.
